```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
raw_fish<-read_csv("data/fish.csv")
clean_fish<-clean_names(raw_fish)
geo<-clean_fish|>filter(genus=="Geotria")
gt(geo)
ggplot(geo,aes(x=total_length_cm))+
  geom_histogram()+
  ggtitle("Distribution of Length of Geotria")+
  xlab("Number of Fish")+
  ylab("Length (cm)")+
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
ggplot(geo, aes(
  x = total_length_cm
)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 bins = 30
  ) +
  ggtitle("Distribution of total length in Geotria fish  - Observed") +
  xlab("Total length (cm)") +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Calculate the observed mean and standard deviation
mean_obs <- mean(pull(geo, total_length_cm))
sd_obs <- sd(pull(geo, total_length_cm))

# Draw the plot
ggplot(geo, aes(
  x = total_length_cm
)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                 bins = 50
  ) +
  stat_function(
    fun = dnorm,
    args = list(mean = mean_obs, sd = sd_obs)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Distribution of total length in Geotria fish  -\nObserved and Theoretical") +
  xlab("Total length (cm)") +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```
